title: Validate result identifiers before filesystem operations

context.hint: Constrain result paths and cleanup operations derived from contributed evaluation inputs.
context.surface: An opt-in local evaluation runner reads case identifiers and copies contributed fixtures into a workspace.
assumptions: A contributor can modify evaluation data or fixtures.
Use disposable roots and outside sentinel fixtures.

review.invariant: Every evaluation result identifier has the required type and its derived path stays within the result root.
review.verification: Use an invalid identifier and verify rejection before executor invocation or filesystem mutation. Preserve an outside sentinel and verify normal integer identifiers as controls.

source_observation.summary: The baseline modified result-related files outside its result root. The repair rejected the invalid identifier before execution and preserved the sentinel. Exposure requires an opt-in behavioral evaluation and is bounded by the runner result suffixes.
